title: Vendor X Rejected
decision: Rejected Vendor X as our primary security compliance partner.
reason: Failed security compliance review. The vendor was unable to provide SOC 2 Type II reports and had outstanding vulnerabilities in their external network penetration tests.

title: Azure to AWS Migration
decision: Migrated core infrastructure from Microsoft Azure to Amazon Web Services (AWS).
reason: Lower operational cost and better scalability. AWS offered a 22% lower TCO over 3 years, along with superior support for our containerized Kubernetes workloads via EKS.

timeline.event: Proof of concept on EKS successful

title: Feature Phoenix Cancelled
decision: Cancelled the development of 'Feature Phoenix' (the real-time collaborative workspace).
reason: Low customer adoption in beta testing and budget constraints. Feedback indicated users preferred third-party integrations over an in-app tool, and the budget was reallocated to core product stability.

title: Project Apollo Delayed
decision: Delayed the launch of Project Apollo (next-gen customer portal) by one quarter.
reason: Third-party dependency delay. The identity provider (IdP) partner delayed their API release, preventing us from implementing single sign-on (SSO) on schedule.

title: CRM Upgrade Approved
decision: Approved upgrading Salesforce CRM to the Unlimited Tier with Einstein AI.
reason: Better automation and reduced maintenance. The upgrade automates lead scoring and contact sync, saving sales reps an estimated 5 hours/week and consolidating external analytics tools.
